message.content: Fix the pattern gaps in PR 490's listing rule. Start from `origin/feat/list-props-by-usage` (head d884334e; `git fetch origin` first; if blocked use existing refs); local branch `fix/list-rule-patterns`; commit in two groups (Step 1 then Step 2), locally; I push onto PR 490's branch. Read FIRST: /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/worker-contract.md (incl. Pre-push gate) and /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/oracle-run/pattern-eval.md (the evaluation: per-library tables, per-pattern verdicts, failure-mode probes (i)-(ix), the 7 proposed rule-level changes), /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/pr/feat-list-props-by-usage.md (the rule as implemented, the memory notes), docs/adr/0028-relevance-evidence-and-the-checker-scheduler.md (A2) and /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/shrink/findings-synthesis.md. THE PRODUCT RULE (the user's, non-negotiable): list EVERYTHING in the main props even if no story uses it, plus anything the component itself uses directly (reads, destructures, passes explicitly; never through a DOM spread); big generated/ambient sources stay as names in a layer; decide by PROVENANCE and STRUCTURE, never by name lists; this is about patterns, not one-off components; 'produce the best results, not the overwhelming numbers'. STEP 1 (highest value, do first, commit): (1) Ambient by DECLARING INTERFACE, not by file: under `@react-types/shared/src/dom.d.ts` only the pure-DOM interfaces (`GlobalDOMAttributes`, `GlobalDOMEvents` and similar) are ambient; React Aria API interfaces declared in the same file (`DOMProps` (id), `AriaLabelingProps`, `FocusableDOMProps` (excludeFromTabOrder), `LinkDOMProps` (routerOptions)) are API sources when at most 200 members: define precisely and by structure (e.g. ambient = declared by React's or the DOM lib's types, or an interface whose members are all native DOM attribute/event names per the DOM/React typings themselves; derive the set from the typings, not a hand-written name list; if you must use a rule on the declaring file, justify and test it), and update crates/core/src/types/ambient.rs / `Origin` / `declaration_origin` accordingly; (2) A member is ambient only when EVERY one of its declarations is ambient (probe ix: `onFocus` declared by a small API interface AND by @types/react `DOMAttributes`; the shadcn aria `Item`); (3) apply the 'generated' rule (a source over 200 members, or a mapped copy of `keyof` a large key set) to PROJECT sources too, while a project source of at most 200 members stays listed (Chakra's own repo Button 147 rows -> about 17; the chakra fixture ~864 -> tens). STEP 2 (commit after Step 1 is green): (4) reads/destructures/passes of a name that sits in a collapsed or more-than-200-member layer of the same props binding promote it to a row (probe v; keep a recipe wrapper's `props.colorPalette`); (5) the mapped-copy rule by the key interface's NATURE: hide a mapped copy only when its key interface is itself generated or ambient (over 200 members, collapsed, ambient) or is a selector/token table (all members string-literal or non-callable values: validate on Chakra `Conditions` (130 keys): if a size-only 200 threshold does not catch Conditions, find the structural signal that does, e.g. every member's type is the same style-object type, and prove it on the corpus; a real 40-key API mapped copy (probe vi) must be listed; (6) follow one-hop aliases of the props binding (`const p = props; p.lang`; `const {title} = p`) as the props binding itself, and fix the over-promotion that lists the whole 55-member `HTMLAttributes` for an aliased destructure with no spread (root-cause it: the pattern-eval report did not); the alias analysis must stay an allow-list: anything not proven is `handed_on`/unknown, per the extractor rules (the T1 body facts in crates/core/src/extractor/body_facts.rs use oxc_semantic symbols: alias = a `const`/`let` initialised with the props identifier, never reassigned); (7) treat `useX(props)` hand-offs as forwarding when the callee's parameter type resolves (like a spread onto a resolved component, T3 forwarding in crates/core/src/relevance/forwarding.rs): the members that parameter type declares from non-ambient sources count as used; unresolved callee = unknown. ACCEPTANCE (re-measure with the evaluation harness in /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/oracle-run/pattern-eval/ (run.sh, eval.py, mixed.py, probes/ with run.sh and show.py): copy and adapt in scratch; do not commit it): (a) real-API rows hidden by mistake: 136 -> 0 on the corpora + fixtures (excludeFromTabOrder, routerOptions, the documented id/aria-label* on React Aria/Spectrum, the shadcn aria Item members); report class (c) counts per library before/after; (b) Spectrum and shadcn rows: report median/p95/total before/after (today Spectrum 11 -> 6 median, 52,011 -> 18,739 total): they will rise by about 4-5 rows per Spectrum component: report it and that no median exceeds a sensible bound (say Spectrum median <= 12); (c) Chakra's own repo Button ~17 rows, Chakra corpus median not above 139; (d) all probes (i)-(ix) PASS in BOTH lanes (checker and --no-checker) and add each probe as a regression test (relevance_model.rs / a new small test file next to it; model-based where it generates components); (e) the main-props differential (0 violations) from the previous round, re-run, and the demo sb-demo Button rows (20 today: as, asChild, css, extra, fresh, html*, kind, loading, loadingText, recipe, size, spinner, spinnerPlacement, tone, unstyled, variant) must not lose any and must not gain any of the 286/706/130 noise; (f) peak RSS shadcn/Chakra within 3% of PR 490's current (975 / 1,819 MiB); (g) CLI JSON still carries the layer names: no information lost. Pre-push gate: invariants in the PR note (unknown unless proven; by binding not spelling; every read recorded; one owner; wired or not defined), grammar sweep over the source/provenance/alias forms (interface, intersection, mapped-over-keyof, Pick/Omit, alias, generic instantiation, ComponentProps<'el'>, forwardRef/memo, factory, hook hand-off, alias chains, shadowing, reassignment), mutation proofs per new rule, ADR 0028 A2 amended via the adr skill (new ambient definition, project-source generated rule, layer promotion, alias and hook forwarding) and the changeset `list-props-by-usage` updated in the user-focused convention of AGENTS.md, `/code-review medium` on your explicit SHA range AWAITED with one fix round. Gates: `just lint doc-check machete typos`, `cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked` (run `pnpm install --offline --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile` first), `just test-checker-lane` (symlink target/release in the worktree to your CARGO_TARGET_DIR/release), `just test-ts`, `just semver`. NOT in scope: the Storybook browser check and the antd/shadcn oracle run (the lead does them after). Own CARGO_TARGET_DIR under /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/shrink/, rust 1.99.1 first on PATH (/Users/gabe/.rustup/toolchains/1.99.1-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin). Update /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/pr/feat-list-props-by-usage.md with the new rule and before/after tables (replace obsolete claims). Final message at most 100 words: SHA, which steps are done, the acceptance numbers (a) to (g), gates exit codes, what remains.

1	# Pattern evaluation: PR 490's listing rule (feat/list-props-by-usage, d884334e) vs main
2	
3	Question: does the rule (main props in full; any member the body reads, destructures or passes by name, but not through a DOM spread; generated or ambient sources stay layer names) work for other components and libraries as a pattern, not as a one-off?
4	
5	Short answer: **mostly yes.** It removes DOM, ARIA and event noise across every library, keeps every own-props component unchanged, and both lanes agree on every probe. It has five rule-level gaps, and four of them hide real API:
6	1. Ambient is decided by file path. React Aria's API interfaces that live in `@react-types/shared/src/dom.d.ts` are therefore hidden.
7	2. A member that @types/react also declares is hidden, even when a small API interface declares it.
8	3. The generated rule does not apply to project sources, so Chakra's own repo still lists 130 condition names on Button.
9	4. Reads do not promote members of collapsed or >200-member sources.
10	5. The mapped-type rule hides a real 40-key API.
11	
12	## Setup
13	
14	- **Main:** `oracle-run/target/release/caliper-docgen`, built 2026-11-15 22:37, 6 minutes after de016f69 (the first-parent tip at the time). I took it to be de016f69 and did not re-verify it by rebuild.
15	- **PR 490:** `shrink/list-main-props/target/release/caliper-docgen`. It was built 2026-11-16 11:36 from worktree `agent-af9171696…` at d884334e, 2 minutes after the commit. Note: `shrink/lpm` is the fix-list-props-memory build (PR 490's "before"), not d884334e, so I did not use it.
16	- **Flags:** `extract --json --quiet --no-cache --load-dependencies --collapse-inherited-props dependencies`, checker on.
17	- **Runs reused:** the PR 490 listed and expanded (`none`) runs on the five corpora are reused from `oracle-run/list-main-props/runs/*.after.json` and `*.expanded.json`. That is the same binary with the same flags.
18	- **Runs made here:**
19	  - main on the five corpora
20	  - main and PR 490 on the repo's `fixtures/`
21	  - PR 490 expanded on `fixtures/`
22	- **Libraries covered:**
23	  - 5 installed corpora: Chakra (`packages/react/src`), Mantine (`@mantine/core`), antd (`components`), shadcn (`apps/v4`), React Spectrum (`packages`)
24	  - 19 of the 20 `fixtures/` libraries (vendored files, @types/react resolved, other deps mostly unresolved): ariakit, ark-ui, base-ui, blueprint, chakra, day-picker, fluentui, headlessui, mantine, mui, panda, radix, react-aria, react-final-form, react-resizable-panels, shadcn, storybook-emotion, tanstack-table, antd, plus rdt-compat
25	- **Scratch** (not in the repo), under `oracle-run/pattern-eval/`:
26	  - `run.sh` (runs)
27	  - `eval.py` (rows, hidden classes, patterns)
28	  - `mixed.py` (multi-declaration and SharedDom audit)
29	  - `patterns.out`
30	  - `probes/` (probe project, `run.sh`, `show.py`, `show.out`)
31	  - `<lib>.out`
32	
33	**Definitions:**
34	- **Rows:** `props` + `notableInherited`.
35	- **Hidden members** are the union of two sets:
36	  - members that are rows on main and not on PR 490;
37	  - names in PR 490 layers whose source (from the expanded run) is non-ambient and has at most 200 members.
38	- **Classes:**
39	  - (a) DOM, ARIA or event, declared under @types/react or `@react-types/shared` `dom.d.ts`
40	  - (b) generated: csstype, `_`-prefixed, a source over 200 members, or a System/Conditions-like source
41	  - (c) real API, declared by the component's own type or by a small (≤200) non-ambient source
42	  - (d) other
43	
44	## Per library (components present in both runs)
45	
46	Each entry gives rows main → 490 as median, p95 and total; how many components grew by more than 30 rows or fell by more than 90%; and the hidden members by class.

91	  - The aria `Item` (`registry/bases/aria/ui/item.tsx`): 8 members (onBlur, onFocus, onKeyDown, onKeyUp, autoFocus, onClick, slot, style). They come from 1 to 3-member React Aria interfaces (`FocusEvents`, `KeyboardEvents`, `PressEvents`, `FocusableProps` in `@react-types/shared/src/events.d.ts`; `SlotProps`, `StyleRenderProps` in react-aria-components `utils.d.ts`). 98	- **Debatable, counted in (a):** `id`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby` and `aria-details` in React Aria's `DOMProps` and `AriaLabelingProps`. They are documented Spectrum API that happen to be DOM-named. 4,584 component rows on Spectrum and 515 on shadcn are hidden.

100	**Top 15 hidden names per library** (count; source and its member count in brackets):
101	- **shadcn:** lang 182, hidden 178, inert 178, translate 178, dir 174 (GlobalDOMAttributes [5], dom.d.ts); aria-describedby 149, aria-details 149, aria-labelledby 149, aria-label 146 (@types/react AriaAttributes [53]); onClick 139 (GlobalDOMEvents [64]); id 121 (DOMProps [1], dom.d.ts); rel 92 (HTMLAttributes [55]); aria-errormessage 83, aria-modal 79 (AriaAttributes); onTransitionCancel 79 (DOMAttributes [170]).

104	- **Mantine:** ref 11 (RefAttributes [1], @types/react); then @types/react members at 2 each: onAnimationEndCapture, onSubmitCapture, about, onLoadedData, onDragEndCapture, title, aria-orientation, onAnimationIterationCapture, onTransitionRunCapture, unselectable, onTouchCancel, onTouchMove, prefix, onFocus.
105	- **Chakra:** @types/react DOM, ARIA and event members, 9 each: onTransitionCancel, aria-describedby, onLostPointerCapture, onLoadedData, onTransitionCancelCapture, aria-errormessage, part, onBeforeInputCapture, popoverTargetAction, onGotPointerCapture, onKeyDown, onScrollEnd, onTransitionStart, aria-valuemax, onDrop.
106	- **ark-ui and react-resizable-panels fixtures:** all @types/react DOMAttributes, AriaAttributes and HTMLAttributes (onStalled, aria-live, defaultChecked…).
107	- **Real-API names among them**, for the lead to eyeball:
108	  - `excludeFromTabOrder`, `routerOptions` (certain)
109	  - `id` and the four `aria-*` labelling props on React Aria and Spectrum (documented)

The chakra fixture has about 864 rows. Cause: "only sources outside the project are narrowed", so the generated rule never applies to an in-repo style system.

114

127	  - Examples: Chakra `ArkEditableTextarea` 429 → 140, still listing `2xl`, `_active`, `_after`…; headlessui `Listbox` 14 → 14.

131	  - Examples: antd `OTPInput` 328 → 29, keeping addonAfter, allowClear, count…; Spectrum `CarouselNavButton` 114 → 39, hiding aria-label, id and `excludeFromTabOrder`.

135	  - Examples: antd `Input.Password` 329 → 29, keeping action, addonAfter, allowClear…; base-ui `MenuRoot` 15 → 15.
136	  - Verdict: **works.**

139	  - Examples: Spectrum `Input` 313 → 8 (UNSAFE_className, placeholder, styles…); ariakit `MenuProvider` 7 → 7.

143	  - Examples: react-aria-components `Tab` 100 → 19, hiding aria-label, href, download and routerOptions (`LinkDOMProps`); antd `Calendar` 25 → 24, hiding `ref`.

# Pattern evaluation: PR 490's listing rule (feat/list-props-by-usage, d884334e) vs main

Question: does the rule (main props in full; any member the body reads, destructures or passes by name, but not through a DOM spread; generated or ambient sources stay layer names) work for other components and libraries as a pattern, not as a one-off?

Short answer: **mostly yes.** It removes DOM, ARIA and event noise across every library, keeps every own-props component unchanged, and both lanes agree on every probe. It has five rule-level gaps, and four of them hide real API:
1. Ambient is decided by file path. React Aria's API interfaces that live in `@react-types/shared/src/dom.d.ts` are therefore hidden.
2. A member that @types/react also declares is hidden, even when a small API interface declares it.
3. The generated rule does not apply to project sources, so Chakra's own repo still lists 130 condition names on Button.
4. Reads do not promote members of collapsed or >200-member sources.
5. The mapped-type rule hides a real 40-key API.

## Setup

- **Main:** `oracle-run/target/release/caliper-docgen`, built 2026-11-15 22:37, 6 minutes after de016f69 (the first-parent tip at the time). I took it to be de016f69 and did not re-verify it by rebuild.

## Not run or not verified

- The 13 non-corpus fixture libraries are vendored files whose dependencies mostly do not resolve. Their dependency-sourced patterns (Radix, MUI, ariakit generics…) are under-tested, and zendesk-garden matched no component.
- No large corpora were fetched (MUI, Radix, ariakit, ark-ui, base-ui, blueprint, fluentui, headlessui and panda as real installs).
- Pattern buckets are regex heuristics. Re-exported dependency components were not detected (0).
- The SharedDom split into API-named and DOM-named members is by interface name (`DOMProps`, `AriaLabelingProps`, `FocusableDOMProps`, `LinkDOMProps`…).
- I did not root-cause the 55-row over-promotion in probe (iii).
- No Storybook rendering was checked, and no oracle was run.

# Findings synthesis (trails 404/405, ~50 Entire findings, 2026-11-15)

Why reviewers keep finding things: every finding is an instance of one of eight classes. Each fix so far closed the
instance, not the class, and most guards are DENY-lists (enumerate what is wrong) where the rule needs an ALLOW-list
(enumerate what is proven, decline the rest). A deny-list is complete only until the next grammar form: the newest
finding (273: `Partial<Config>` with a `[Symbol.iterator]` key) is the same class as the six before it.

| # | Class (semantic invariant that was broken) | Findings (change) | Class-level remedy |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | Silence is not evidence: absent data was treated as 'complete/none' | declare fn = complete empty body, optional-chain computed member (268); alias Pick over checker-only source collapses (267 x6); name-only filter hides another source's prop (277); `used` empty (281) | Unknown is the default state; Complete is earned. Exhaustive `match` on node/type kinds, no wildcard arm, the default arm is `Unknown`/`Declined`. One rule in the one decision function: not proven => keep listed. |
| C2 | Lossy model asserted exactness (deny-list guard) | Omit/keyof index sig, Array shadow, scope, Partial<Dict>, readonly, Required undefined (273), Symbol.iterator key (273 new) | ALLOW-list expansion: expand only members of a closed set of simple forms (identifier or string-literal key, plain/optional/readonly known, non-generic), decline everything else. Oracle generator iterates the GRAMMAR of member/key forms, not the findings. |
| C3 | Spelling used where binding is required | JSX usage by name, builtin `Array` by spelling, shadowed tags, AtFile scope, three path predicates for ambient/React | Resolve by binding or return unknown; one `declaration_origin`; no string equality on identifiers in decisions. |
| C4 | Derived state outside the dependency model | stale watch/lazy relevance (281), call-site cache, scheduler re-ask after edit (279/282) | Everything an answer reads is recorded (`deps`) or the answer is not kept; `watch_equals_fresh` model with mutation proof per dependency kind. |
| C5 | One decision, two owners | collapse lanes (267, 4 rounds), picked keys (4 readers), `annotate` x3, `{...props}` meaning, relevance map vs ADR | One function, one sink, provenance `(source, key, how)` not counts/names; lanes feed inputs, never decide. |
| C6 | Host assumptions | cgroup v1 mount (272) | Read the system's own description (mountinfo); fall back loudly. Fixed. |
| C7 | Hand-tuned policy without a reference model | scheduler fairness/starvation (279/281) | Property test against a reference model (sort by class, arrival) with the starvation rule as the spec. |
| C8 | Contract drift: code, ADR, schema disagree; fields defined but never populated | schema 8 per-component map vs ADR `used`, dead story-args, `used` empty on corpora, 281 | ADR is the contract; a field ships only with a producer, a consumer and a corpus count that is non-zero. |

Plus a process class: stacked PRs show the same code in every child (about 40% of the raw count) and merge commits
re-expose it. Remedy: merge in order, review once, retarget children.

## Pre-push gate (every slice, before the Entire reviewer ever sees it)

1. Invariants: write the 3 to 6 invariants of the slice in the PR body in these terms: 'unknown unless proven',
   'resolved by binding', 'every read recorded', 'one owner', 'wired or not defined'.
2. Grammar sweep: list every syntactic or type form the touched code can receive (all AST node kinds, all member
   and key forms, all declaration kinds) and show each one is handled or lands in the Unknown/Declined arm, by an
   EXHAUSTIVE match (no `_ =>`) or a generated test over the grammar with the oracle (checker, TS API) as judge.
3. Mutation proof: for each guard or dependency, remove it and show a test fails. A guard no test can fail is not a guard.
4. Adversarial pass: a reviewer that did not write the code gets the pattern list C1 to C8 and the grammar list and
   must try to produce a wrong output (not read the diff for style). Fix once, at the class level.
5. Then `/code-review medium` on the explicit SHA range, then push.
## What

Slice T4 of ADR 0028 (trail 405), reworked after the owner clarified what "use" means: "We want to make sure we're providing everything in the main props even if the story doesn't use them. And anything that the actual Button component uses directly." The rows a user sees (`props` and `notableInherited`, which Storybook turns into Controls) follow one placement computed by `relevance::decide`. Both lanes go through one sink (`relevance::apply`, then `narrow` again after each checker merge).

**The rule (`decide`).** A member is a typed row when:
1. the props type declares it itself (own, picked, overriding, required or defaulted); or
2. its source is an API source: not ambient (React's or the shared DOM declarations, decided by declaring path) and not generated; or
3. the component's body reads it, destructures it (with or without a default) or passes it by name, or a spread onto a resolved component forwards it, from any source, DOM attributes included; or
4. it is passed at the call-site floor (`max(2, 20%)` of the call sites). This now only matters for ambient or generated members.

Everything else is a name in its source's layer. A spread onto a DOM tag is no evidence. A body that hands its props on, or spreads onto a tag that did not resolve, promotes nothing and hides nothing: `decide` no longer reads completeness, so `Body::handed_on` and `Shown`'s `used` and `unknown` lists are gone. Story `args` are not read: Storybook already adds a control for every arg a story sets (`children` on the demo Button).

**Generated, by structure and provenance, never by name.** A member is generated (`Member::large`) when:
- the resolver collapsed its source into a layer; or
- its source reaches with more than `LARGE_API_SOURCE` (200) members (Chakra's `SystemProperties`, 706); or
- a homomorphic mapped type copies it from `keyof` an interface of more than `COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD` (30) members (Chakra's `Conditions`, 130: `_hover`, `_active`, `2xl`...). The structural resolver marks such a member with `ParsedProp::copied_from_large_keys`. The flag is `#[serde(skip)]`, so the output is unchanged.

**Why not size alone.** A size-only rule at 30 catches `Conditions` but also hides real dependency APIs of 31 to 75 members on the corpora: rc-component `MenuProps` (33), `BaseSelectProps` (41 to 45), `TreeProps` (39), react-day-picker `PropsBase` (75), MUI `InputBaseProps` (34 to 39), zag `ComboboxProps` (38). It does not give the same results, so the mapped rule stays. The mapped form alone is not enough either: Chakra's recipe props use it too (`ButtonVariantProps = { [K in keyof ButtonVariant]?: … }`, giving `size` and `variant`). The key interface's size decides: 130 keys against 2.

**What is unchanged from the earlier T4 work.** Provenance (a listed prop leaves only when its name and `parent` match). Only sources outside the project are narrowed. `collapseInheritedProps: none` narrows nothing. Declined key sets. JSX children pass `children`. `htmlAttributes` still says which DOM attributes are known. The memory representation of PR "fix-list-props-memory" (sources grouped once per component) is unchanged.

ADR 0028 A2 is amended with the exact rule and the owner's clarification. The `list-props-by-usage` changeset is rewritten in the user's terms.

Invariants:
- Unknown unless proven: an unknown body neither promotes nor hides. A prop with no `parent` is never narrowed, and is generated only when the resolver marked it as copied.
- By binding, not spelling: ambient by declaring path; generated by layer, size or the resolver's mapped-type mark; no name lists in `decide`.
- One owner: `decide` decides once, from the structural answer; `narrow` enforces it in both lanes.
- Wired or not defined: the completeness fields `decide` no longer reads were removed from `relevance::Body` and `Forwarding`.

## Evidence

**sb-demo Button** (`ButtonProps & React.ComponentProps<'button'> & { tone, fresh, size, kind, extra }`, body `<button {...props} />`). CLI `extract --load-dependencies --collapse-inherited-props dependencies`, decoded by `oracle-run/list-main-props/rows.py`:
- Before (PR 490 head): 9 rows: extra, fresh, kind, loading, recipe, size, spinnerPlacement, tone, variant. Storybook showed these plus `children` (10).
- After: 20 rows, the same in both lanes: as, asChild, css, extra, fresh, htmlContent, htmlHeight, htmlSize, htmlTranslate, htmlWidth, kind, loading, loadingText, recipe, size, spinner, spinnerPlacement, tone, unstyled, variant. Storybook adds `children` from the story's args, for 21.
- Chakra `ButtonProps`' non-generated members in the installed `@chakra-ui/react`, all listed:
  - `ButtonLoadingProps`: loading, loadingText, spinner, spinnerPlacement
  - `RecipeProps<"button">`: recipe, plus `ButtonVariant`'s size and variant
  - `UnstyledProp`: unstyled
  - `PolymorphicProps`: as, asChild
  - `JsxStyleProps`: css
  - `HtmlProps`: htmlSize, htmlWidth, htmlHeight, htmlTranslate, htmlContent
- `colorPalette` is not in that list: in the installed types it is a member of `SystemProperties` (system.gen.d.ts:790), so it stays a layer name.
- Layers: `React.ComponentProps` (286), `SystemProperties` (706) and `Conditions` (130) are names only, with no `used`.
- Badge (`ComponentProps<'span'>`): 2 rows (asChild, variant), as before.

**Main-props differential** (requirement c). For every component, the rows of the expanded view (collapse `none`) that have no `parent`, or whose source has at most 30 members and is not ambient, must be listed. Violations:
- gate-large 0 of 938
- chakra-only 0 of 788
- Chakra 0 of 629
- Mantine 0 of 348
- antd 0 of 254
- shadcn 0 of 1,901
- Spectrum 0 of 1,415

That Spectrum note is still true: if the owner wants SharedDom listed, it is one line in `origin.rs`. Script: `oracle-run/list-main-props/rows.py diff`.

**New rule tests, both lanes** (requirement b):
- `relevance_model::the_main_props_and_the_members_the_body_names_are_listed_and_nothing_a_dom_spread_passes`. Over 30 generated components, bodies read `rest.dN`, destructure `{ dN }` or `{ dN = 'v' }`, pass `<Child v={rest.dN} />`, and spread the rest onto `<div>`. The source is a 40-member ambient source under `@types/react`. In both lanes, the rows equal own, plus the API source, plus exactly the DOM members named.
- The existing lane-agreement model now also compares rows.
- Unit tests: `a_member_the_body_uses_is_a_row_from_any_source`, `every_member_of_an_api_source_is_a_row_without_evidence`, `an_unknown_body_promotes_nothing_and_hides_nothing`, and `a_mapped_type_over_the_keys_of_a_large_interface_is_generated_and_over_a_small_one_is_api` (2, 30 and 31 keys).

- Chakra: median 139 → 139, total 81,914 → 81,972
- Mantine: 72 → 72, total 20,294 → 20,348
- antd: 12 → 13, total 4,709 → 4,975
- shadcn: 2 → 3, total 8,738 → 11,142
- Spectrum: 6 → 6, total 18,647 → 18,739
- gate-large: 139 → 139
- chakra-only: 139 → 139

`Button` rows:
- Chakra's own repo: 147 → 147
- Mantine: 86 → 86
- antd: 25 → 27 (autoFocus and style, which the body uses)
- shadcn aria: 40 → 40
- shadcn new-york: 8 → 8
- Spectrum s2: 39 → 39
- react-aria-components: 38 → 38
- sb-demo (Chakra demo): 9 → 20

Most of shadcn's growth is `className`, which its components destructure: it is now a typed row instead of a `used` name.

**Peak RSS** (`/usr/bin/time -l`, `--no-cache`, 3 interleaved runs, median, MiB), PR 490 head → this branch:
- shadcn: 972 → 975
- Chakra: 1,815 → 1,819

Both are within 1%. The PR 490 figures were 976 and 1,825. Single runs:
- Mantine: 849 → 854
- antd: 1,058 → 1,055

Two runs (one per binary, in different rounds) fell back to the structural lane with "the heap held 17592186044404 MiB". That is a bogus value, pre-existing in the before binary too. Those runs were dropped from the medians.

**Mutation proofs** (one at a time, each reverted). Each mutation made tests fail, except one:
- Size ignored in `api`: 52 tests fail.
- Reads promote nothing: 14 fail.
- Forwarding promotes nothing: 12 fail.
- The call-site floor promotes nothing: 4 fail.
- Layers not counted toward size: 6 fail.
- Ambient not treated as generated: 18 fail.
- Survived: an off-by-one on the 30 threshold. That was in the first design. The final design is tested at 30 and 31 keys by the mapped-type test, but that test was not re-run as a mutation.

**Review.** `/code-review medium 24438c48..2f234371` returned 9 findings. Fixed in d884334e:
- Size 30 hid real 31-to-200-member dependency APIs (findings 1 and 2). Now `LARGE_API_SOURCE`, plus the mapped rule.
- Stale module docs and comments (findings 6 and 7).
- Test names that still said "unknown" (finding 8).

Not fixed:
- 3: a `(type name, file)` source key can merge two `__type` literals of one file. The narrowing provenance uses the same key.
- 4: a prop with no `parent` is never generated unless the resolver marked it. Intended: an unknown source never hides.
- 5: `BodyFacts::handed_on` is still computed and cached, but nothing reads it. Removing it means a cache schema bump.
- 9: destructured DOM props are now typed rows. Intended by the owner's rule.

**Gates** (head d884334e):
- `pnpm install --offline --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile`: exit 0
- `cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked`: exit 0 (1,650 run, 1,650 passed)
- `just lint doc-check machete typos`: exit 0
- `just test-checker-lane`: exit 0 (254 fixtures, 0 differ)
- `just test-ts`: exit 0

- Storybook dev-mode rows for the final head were not measured: the call cap ran out. The CLI gives 20 rows in both lanes, and Storybook adds `children` from args. The napi library is built at `shrink/list-main-props/target/release`, but it was not copied into sb-demo.
- Oracle (`scripts/weekly.py --oracle --corpus antd --corpus shadcn`) was not run: the call cap ran out. The expanded view (collapse `none`), which the oracle measures, is not changed by `decide`.

- The 30-threshold mutation was not re-run on the final design.

| C6 | Host assumptions | cgroup v1 mount (272) | Read the system's own description (mountinfo); fall back loudly. Fixed. |
| C7 | Hand-tuned policy without a reference model | scheduler fairness/starvation (279/281) | Property test against a reference model (sort by class, arrival) with the starvation rule as the spec. |
| C8 | Contract drift: code, ADR, schema disagree; fields defined but never populated | schema 8 per-component map vs ADR `used`, dead story-args, `used` empty on corpora, 281 | ADR is the contract; a field ships only with a producer, a consumer and a corpus count that is non-zero. |

Plus a process class: stacked PRs show the same code in every child (about 40% of the raw count) and merge commits
re-expose it. Remedy: merge in order, review once, retarget children.

## Pre-push gate (every slice, before the Entire reviewer ever sees it)

1. Invariants: write the 3 to 6 invariants of the slice in the PR body in these terms: 'unknown unless proven',
   'resolved by binding', 'every read recorded', 'one owner', 'wired or not defined'.
2. Grammar sweep: list every syntactic or type form the touched code can receive (all AST node kinds, all member
   and key forms, all declaration kinds) and show each one is handled or lands in the Unknown/Declined arm, by an
   EXHAUSTIVE match (no `_ =>`) or a generated test over the grammar with the oracle (checker, TS API) as judge.
3. Mutation proof: for each guard or dependency, remove it and show a test fails. A guard no test can fail is not a guard.
4. Adversarial pass: a reviewer that did not write the code gets the pattern list C1 to C8 and the grammar list and
   must try to produce a wrong output (not read the diff for style). Fix once, at the class level.
5. Then `/code-review medium` on the explicit SHA range, then push.
## What

Slice T4 of ADR 0028 (trail 405), reworked after the owner clarified what "use" means: "We want to make sure we're providing everything in the main props even if the story doesn't use them. And anything that the actual Button component uses directly." The rows a user sees (`props` and `notableInherited`, which Storybook turns into Controls) follow one placement computed by `relevance::decide`. Both lanes go through one sink (`relevance::apply`, then `narrow` again after each checker merge).

**The rule (`decide`).** A member is a typed row when:
1. the props type declares it itself (own, picked, overriding, required or defaulted); or
2. its source is an API source: not ambient (React's or the shared DOM declarations, decided by declaring path) and not generated; or
3. the component's body reads it, destructures it (with or without a default) or passes it by name, or a spread onto a resolved component forwards it, from any source, DOM attributes included; or
4. it is passed at the call-site floor (`max(2, 20%)` of the call sites). This now only matters for ambient or generated members.

Everything else is a name in its source's layer. A spread onto a DOM tag is no evidence. A body that hands its props on, or spreads onto a tag that did not resolve, promotes nothing and hides nothing: `decide` no longer reads completeness, so `Body::handed_on` and `Shown`'s `used` and `unknown` lists are gone. Story `args` are not read: Storybook already adds a control for every arg a story sets (`children` on the demo Button).

**Generated, by structure and provenance, never by name.** A member is generated (`Member::large`) when:
- the resolver collapsed its source into a layer; or
- its source reaches with more than `LARGE_API_SOURCE` (200) members (Chakra's `SystemProperties`, 706); or
- a homomorphic mapped type copies it from `keyof` an interface of more than `COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD` (30) members (Chakra's `Conditions`, 130: `_hover`, `_active`, `2xl`...). The structural resolver marks such a member with `ParsedProp::copied_from_large_keys`. The flag is `#[serde(skip)]`, so the output is unchanged.

**Why not size alone.** A size-only rule at 30 catches `Conditions` but also hides real dependency APIs of 31 to 75 members on the corpora: rc-component `MenuProps` (33), `BaseSelectProps` (41 to 45), `TreeProps` (39), react-day-picker `PropsBase` (75), MUI `InputBaseProps` (34 to 39), zag `ComboboxProps` (38). It does not give the same results, so the mapped rule stays. The mapped form alone is not enough either: Chakra's recipe props use it too (`ButtonVariantProps = { [K in keyof ButtonVariant]?: … }`, giving `size` and `variant`). The key interface's size decides: 130 keys against 2.

**What is unchanged from the earlier T4 work.** Provenance (a listed prop leaves only when its name and `parent` match). Only sources outside the project are narrowed. `collapseInheritedProps: none` narrows nothing. Declined key sets. JSX children pass `children`. `htmlAttributes` still says which DOM attributes are known. The memory representation of PR "fix-list-props-memory" (sources grouped once per component) is unchanged.

ADR 0028 A2 is amended with the exact rule and the owner's clarification. The `list-props-by-usage` changeset is rewritten in the user's terms.

Invariants:
- Unknown unless proven: an unknown body neither promotes nor hides. A prop with no `parent` is never narrowed, and is generated only when the resolver marked it as copied.
- By binding, not spelling: ambient by declaring path; generated by layer, size or the resolver's mapped-type mark; no name lists in `decide`.
- One owner: `decide` decides once, from the structural answer; `narrow` enforces it in both lanes.
- Wired or not defined: the completeness fields `decide` no longer reads were removed from `relevance::Body` and `Forwarding`.

24	**Ambient** is decided by where a member is declared, not by its name: a member `@types/react` declares (by declaring path, as `is_react_declared` in `crates/semantic/src/component.rs` recognizes React terminals), or one that reaches the component only through a spread onto a DOM tag. Each lane computes the bit for each prop and hands it to `decide` in `Evidence` (`is_react_declared` is private to `caliper-docgen-semantic`, which core does not depend on); `decide` never recomputes it, and a model test in the style of the collapse PR's `collapse_model.rs` holds the two lanes to the same bits. `ambient.rs`'s name clauses and `notable_html_attrs` stay as the unknown-evidence fallback until the T5 gate shows evidence replaces them; then they are deleted (slice R9).
25	
26	**Combination.** One function, `relevance::decide(&Evidence) -> Shown`, owns it, as `CollapseInheritedProps::collapses` owns collapsing; both lanes and every surface call it.
27	
28	- Shown as a row: own, picked, overriding, required, defaulted; a non-ambient member that is forwarded, read, or passed at the floor.
29	- Named in the layer's `used` list: an ambient member passed at the floor or read in the body.
30	- Left in a collapsed layer: everything else with complete evidence, even from a source today's rule lists (its source becomes a layer). A non-ambient member with unknown body evidence and no other signal is listed or collapsed as today.
31	
32	**Output.** A collapsed `InheritedLayer` (`crates/core/src/types/output.rs:83`) gains `used`: the names of its members that evidence put forward, written once as a name list (ADR 0018), not as typed rows. Universal props such as `className`, `style` and `id` cost a name each instead of a row each. A `React.ComponentProps<"el">` layer also gets its `members`, so a reader can check `used` against it. No per-prop flag in this ADR: the row/layer split already says shown or not, and why a row is shown is for the agent output, deferred. `SCHEMA_VERSION` goes from 7 to 8 (ADR 0017), with the RDT view, the JSON schema, `binding.d.ts` and a changeset.
33	
34	**Consumers.** The Storybook addon makes argTypes from rows, then one name-only row per `used` name with the layer as its category; an option (`relevance: 'all'`) asks for the expanded output, which is today's `collapseInheritedProps: 'none'`. CLI JSON and TOON carry the same output. Agent output keeps its current form until the agent flow is narrowed.
35	
36	**Acceptance gate** (T5's metric, ported into the weekly by T4). Coverage counts a passed prop as visible when it is a row or in `used`. Call-site evidence is computed from half of the files (by path hash) and coverage is measured on the other half, so the gate does not pass by construction. On the half the floor is `max(1, 20%)`, and only components with at least 6 sites are measured, so the gate does not test a stricter rule than the one shipped.
37	
38	- Coverage mean rises: shadcn 0.43 to at least 0.70; Mantine 0.86 to at least 0.88; antd 0.91 to at least 0.93; Spectrum stays at least 0.96.
39	- Rows shown fall: the median rows per component does not rise on any corpus (Mantine 77, Spectrum 74, shadcn 3, antd 17), and total rows fall on Mantine and Spectrum. Chakra `Button`'s typed rows stay at or under 146 (its `used` names come on top and are reported apart).
40	- These targets are proposals. Only the extra-entry costs above were measured; the fall in rows is not predicted.
41	
42	### A2. The listing follows the decision (slice T4, amended 2026-11-16)
43	
44	Measured at de016f69 (`caliper-fixtures/oracle-run/diagnosis.md`): Storybook listed 437 Controls rows for a demo Chakra `Button` and 280 for a `ComponentProps<'span'>` `Badge`, because `decide` only wrote `used` lists while `htmlAttributes: 'full'` (ADR 0023) and the session merge (`checker_prop_used`) listed every `@types/react` attribute; the CLI merge dropped them all where a layer existed, so the lanes disagreed (Button 150, Badge 2). Changes to section A:
45	
46	- **One placement, every lane.** `relevance::apply` keeps `decide`'s placement on the entry (`ComponentEntry::relevance`, not serialized) and lists by it (`relevance::narrow`); both checker merges call `narrow` again after laying out the checker's props, and take a `@types/react` prop only where the structural answer lists it (`react_prop_listed`), whatever the mode. A listed prop the placement leaves out moves to its source's layer as a name: the layer of its `parent`, else the element layer for an ambient source, else a new layer of that parent. A prop with no `parent` stays listed, so no name is lost.
47	- **Scope.** Only props a source outside the project declares (a dependency's, React's or the DOM's, by declaring path) are narrowed; the project's own sources keep the collapse rule until a later slice measures them. `collapseInheritedProps: none` narrows nothing: it is the expanded view (`relevance: 'all'`).
48	- **Rows: the main props in full, plus what the component uses** (amended again 2026-11-16 after the owner clarified "use": "everything in the main props even if the story doesn't use them, and anything the actual component uses directly", not "used in a story"). `decide` lists a member as a typed row when:
49	  1. the props type declares it itself (own, picked, overriding, required or defaulted); or
50	  2. its source is an API source: not ambient (by declaring path) and not generated (`Member::large`). Generated means: a source the resolver collapsed (a layer), a source reaching with more than `LARGE_API_SOURCE` (200) members, or a member a homomorphic mapped type copies from `keyof` an interface of more than `COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD` (30) members (`ParsedProp::copied_from_large_keys`, set by the structural resolver). No story or call site is needed; or
51	  3. the body reads it, destructures it (with or without a default) or passes it by name, or a spread onto a resolved component forwards it (that component's non-ambient props), whatever its source; or
52	  4. it is passed at the call-site floor, which now only matters for members of ambient or large sources.
53	
54	  Everything else (the rest of `@types/react`'s and the shared DOM attributes, Chakra's `SystemProperties` and `Conditions`) is a name in its source's layer. A spread onto a DOM tag is no evidence. A body that hands its props on, or spreads onto a tag that did not resolve, promotes nothing and hides nothing: completeness no longer enters `decide` (`Body::handed_on` is gone). A row whose member the answer holds only as a layer name (a source the resolver collapsed) is named in that layer's `used` list, the only use `used` keeps. Story `args` are not read: Storybook already makes a control for every arg a story sets (`children` on the demo `Button`).
55	
56	  Why the mapped form and not a lower size cut: a size-only rule at 30 would catch Chakra's `Conditions` (130 keys) but also hide real dependency APIs of 31 to 75 members on the corpora (rc-component `MenuProps` 33, `BaseSelectProps` 41 to 45, `TreeProps` 39, react-day-picker `PropsBase` 75, MUI `InputBaseProps` 34 to 39, zag `ComboboxProps` 38), so it does not give the same results. The form alone is not enough either: Chakra's recipe props use it too (`ButtonVariantProps = { [K in keyof ButtonVariant]?: … }`, `size` and `variant`), so the key interface's size (130 against 2) decides, at the threshold the resolver uses for ambient sources.
57	
58	- **Provenance, not names.** The placement keeps each left-out member with the source the structural answer gives it (`parent`, or the collapsed layer holding it); a merge narrows a listed prop only when name and source both match, so a same-named prop of another source is never hidden and a member with no structural source is narrowed in neither lane. A homomorphic mapped type's member (`{ [K in keyof Conditions]?: V }`) keeps its key's interface as `parent`, as the checker does.
59	- **Declined key sets.** A `Pick` or `Omit` (in place or behind an alias) whose keys are not a closed set of string literals narrows no non-ambient source: which members reach is unproven (findings D5). Keys a `Pick` names through `Omit`, `Partial`, `Required`, `Readonly` or a project alias are picked.
60	- **JSX children** pass `children` at a call site, after every attribute, as the JSX transform does; layout whitespace and empty expressions pass nothing.
61	- **`htmlAttributes`** (ADR 0023 is cited by `options.rs` but not in `docs/adr`; this amends its contract here) says which DOM attributes are known (as rows or layer names), not how many rows a reader sees; `full` stays the default because a passed attribute can be a typed row only if it is known. `notable_html_attrs` still feeds `curated` mode only; it no longer decides rows under the default, and R9 deletes it.

**Consumers.** The Storybook addon makes argTypes from rows, then one name-only row per `used` name with the layer as its category; an option (`relevance: 'all'`) asks for the expanded output, which is today's `collapseInheritedProps: 'none'`. **Acceptance gate** (T5's metric, ported into the weekly by T4). Coverage counts a passed prop as visible when it is a row or in `used`. ### A2. The listing follows the decision (slice T4, amended 2026-11-16)

Measured at de016f69 (`caliper-fixtures/oracle-run/diagnosis.md`): Storybook listed 437 Controls rows for a demo Chakra `Button` and 280 for a `ComponentProps<'span'>` `Badge`, because `decide` only wrote `used` lists while `htmlAttributes: 'full'` (ADR 0023) and the session merge (`checker_prop_used`) listed every `@types/react` attribute; the CLI merge dropped them all where a layer existed, so the lanes disagreed (Button 150, Badge 2).
